nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address that gates onlyOwner functionality
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and promoted by acceptOwnership
FZB.symbol token ticker set in the constructor
FZB.name human readable token name set in the constructor
FZB.decimals precision, initialized to 18
FZB._totalSupply: aggregate token supply, minted once and reduced by burn
FZB.balances: mapping of holder address to token balance
FZB.allowed: nested mapping of owner to spender allowances
SafeMath.safeAdd: adds two values and requires the result did not wrap
SafeMath.safeSub: requires b <= a before subtracting
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplies and validates against overflow
SafeMath.safeDiv: requires non-zero divisor before dividing
Owned constructor: assigns msg.sender as the initial owner
Owned.transferOwnership: owner-only nomination of a new owner
Owned.acceptOwnership: pending owner accepts and ownership is transferred
Owned.onlyOwner modifier: requires msg.sender == owner and gates privileged entry points
FZB constructor: sets metadata, mints the full supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer
FZB.totalSupply: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with raw unchecked subtraction
FZB.balanceOf: read-only accessor for balances
FZB.transfer: debits msg.sender and credits recipient using safeSub/safeAdd
FZB.approve: writes an arbitrary allowance for msg.sender with no return value check
FZB.transferFrom: spends allowance and moves tokens between two arbitrary accounts
FZB.allowance: read-only accessor for the allowed mapping
FZB.approveAndCall: sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on a caller-supplied contract
FZB fallback: payable function that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH
FZB.transferAnyERC20Token: owner-only rescue that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract
FZB.burn: owner-only burn that debits msg.sender balance and _totalSupply
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization and balance accounting
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with user data before returning success
